use_cases: Command palette for quickly executing actions with keyboard shortcuts
Search interface with categorized suggestions and debounced input
Action launcher for navigating between features or commands
Quick search with expandable animated results panel
Universal search bar with icon-labeled action items
ai_summary: A modern search bar component featuring action buttons, categorized suggestions, and keyboard shortcuts like ⌘K. Includes debounced input, expandable animated results using motion/react, and supports icons with metadata like short descriptions and end labels. Designed as a command palette interface for SaaS and dev tools platforms with seamless desktop and mobile support.
